annotations.title: Resolve names to ids, find by meaning, list facets

description: Resolve up to 5 names, domains, URLs, or question wordings to Parse ids, with match scores and brand index status. Use kinds: ["facet"], ["surface"], or ["measure"] for filter values, AI surfaces, or metric definitions. For tool arguments pass kinds: ["argument"] and tool names in q. Free.

explain.description: false: omit data.note, context.measures, and verbose cite attribution (keeps scope, caveats, dataChanges, window)

kinds.description: what to match: brand, topic, question, market, page, site, place (default all); or facet, surface, measure alone for the dictionary; argument alone, with tool names in q: what a tool takes beyond its tools/list entry

match.description: name: exact names, domains and ids (the search by meaning needs sign-in)

q.description: up to 5 names, domains, URLs, question wordings or typed ids; the dictionary takes search words or none; kinds argument takes tool names

unit.description: dictionary only: facets of this unit (answer, mention, evidence, comparison, page, page_brand, question, topic_brand)

name: resolve_ids
